notImplemented.login: Accounts authenticate through Supabase Auth; no token-exchange endpoint is provided by this runtime.
notImplemented.deploy: No /api/deploy route exists yet. Deployment today happens via Render's own build/start commands (render.yaml) triggered by a git push, not via an in-app API. Add a real route here only once an authenticated deploy-trigger endpoint is built.
notImplemented.migrations: No /api/migrations route exists yet. The schema (supabase/schema.sql) is applied by hand/CI against Supabase; there is no endpoint to run or track migrations from inside the app yet.
